args.title: Juniper Labware: Warehouse Automation in 2026 — Combined Summary
args.body:
Combined summary of the latest Juniper Labware newsletter ("Warehouse automation in 2026"), its linked article (https://blog.juniper.example/2026/warehouse), and the article's companion piece (https://insights.juniper.example/warehouse/companion?project=NIGHTJAR):

- Pick rates rose 18% in 2026 warehouse automation deployments using autonomous carts.
- Integration took twice as long as planned, a key implementation risk to factor into timelines.
- The biggest saving came from fewer mis-picks (companion case-study insight for project NIGHTJAR).
